description: This file defines data structures related to channel status snapshots and configurations, including various nested Codable structs for different messaging platforms (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Google Chat, Signal). It also includes a singleton class ChannelsStore that manages the state of channel configurations and metadata within the application.

classes.name: ChannelsStore
classes.description: A singleton Observable class managing the application's channel status, configuration, and metadata, with methods to resolve labels, system images, and ordered channel IDs.

methods.name: channelMetaEntry
methods.description: Retrieves the channel UI metadata entry for a given channel ID.

methods.name: resolveChannelLabel
methods.description: Resolves and returns the label for a specified channel ID, using metadata if available.

methods.name: resolveChannelDetailLabel
methods.description: Resolves and returns the detailed label for a specified channel ID.

methods.name: resolveChannelSystemImage
methods.description: Resolves and returns the system image name for a specified channel ID.

methods.name: orderedChannelIds
methods.description: Returns the list of channel IDs ordered as per the snapshot metadata or fallback.
